name: Japheth
bio: Japheth is Noah's third son, whose descendants scattered into "the isles of the Gentiles" — the peoples of the Mediterranean coastlands and beyond (Genesis 10:2-5). After the flood, he joined his brother Shem in respectfully covering their drunken, exposed father, and so was blessed alongside Shem: "God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem" (Genesis 9:23-27) — foreshadowing that the Gentiles would one day share in the spiritual blessings given to Israel.
